g.text: SuperMAS Email Assistant — Proposed UML Class Diagram
Each owns a prompt and allowed sources.
Assembly includes the email, selected knowledge,
allowed history and explicit user feedback.
Enforce a context budget before inference.
records drafts, feedback and sent mail
Black diamond: configuration ownership; white diamond: registry aggregation.
AgentRequest, AgentResult, DraftStatus and SendResult are supporting types
omitted from the diagram for readability. No implementation is implied.
